integrity: Exact proof relies on fiber and correlation counts in the text. Accompanying exhaustive finite-field code corroborates but does not establish the all-n theorem. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Local second-order analysis only for q a power of three; no global sharp norm or global extremizer classification in characteristic three. No field-uniform neighborhood. Unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
title: Exact local sixth-moment stability of the parabola in characteristic three
